commitMessage: fix(gate26): bound predictive engine cache to 128 entries

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: The Owner-issued LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY document for this causally rebuilt bounded engine-cache maintenance. Bootstrap member: it must be readable to evaluate the program, so it is pre-state self-excluded while remaining inside the authorized set and inside the consumption cohort.
This authorized-path manifest. Bootstrap member: it must be readable to evaluate the program, so it is pre-state self-excluded while remaining digest-pinned by the authority.

Bound the module-level ensemble CACHE to exactly 128 entries with deterministic FIFO eviction on insertion order. The cached payload is never returned as authoritative output; combineFrozenSelection always recomputes. Selection, scoring, ABSTAIN, horizons, provenance, schemas and output bytes are unchanged. Grants no permission to generate any GATE26 FULL product byte and no Phase D readiness.

Add hostile regression coverage for the bounded cache: exact 128 retention, single deterministic eviction at 129, 20,000 unique identities never exceeding 128, deterministic survivors, existing-key rewrite without growth or FIFO refresh, evicted-identity recomputation byte identity, and preservation of the existing STALE_CACHE_SILENT_HIT_FORBIDDEN refusals. No stale inherited governance assertion is repaired.

Assert that forced cache eviction and recomputation reproduce byte-identical MINI product bytes across the serialized replay boundary, so bounding the cache cannot alter replay identity, scoring, selection, ABSTAIN or horizon outputs.
